title: Alert Discord When a File Changes with Python
hook_text: Discord alert when a file changes
description: Send an immediate Discord notification whenever a critical vendor document or price sheet changes. This 10-line Python script fingerprints the file and pings your channel automatically.

beats.voice: Your Discord gets pinged the exact second a supplier quietly updates their pricing PDF.
Read the file as raw bytes, then calculate its unique SHA-256 fingerprint.
Next, compare that hash against the previous run stored in a tiny cache file.
When the hash shifts, post an instant webhook payload straight to your channel and store the update.
This catches raw byte alterations rather than text diffs, keeping you fully protected whenever...

kit_readme:
SETUP
1. Ensure Python 3.8+ is installed.
2. Install required dependencies:
   pip install requests
3. Obtain an incoming webhook URL from your Discord channel settings (Integrations -> Webhooks).

HOW IT WORKS
tool.py computes a SHA-256 cryptographic digest of a target file using streamed chunks to keep memory usage low.
It reads the previous hash from a local cache file (.tool_state.hash by default).
If the file is new, it records a baseline.
If the file has changed, it dispatches an automated notification message to Discord and writes the new hash to disk once delivery succeeds.

Usage:
python tool.py --target supplier_price_sheet.pdf --webhook https://discord.com/api/webhooks/YOUR_KEY

Test run without triggering alerts or rewriting state:
python tool.py --target supplier_price_sheet.pdf --webhook https://discord.com/api/webhooks/YOUR_KEY --dry-run

ADAPTING IT
- Schedule execution every 15 minutes using cron (Linux/macOS) or Windows Task Scheduler.
- Swap the Discord POST call for Telegram, Slack, or generic HTTP endpoint by adjusting the JSON payload structure.
- Monitor multiple files by pointing distinct state files per file via the --state flag.

LIMITATIONS
- The script checks byte alterations via SHA-256; it does not parse or extract human-readable text diffs.
- Requires local or mounted read access to the targeted file.

product_blurb: Automate instant channel notifications whenever important local spreadsheets, PDFs, or contracts change. Prevent missed vendor updates with clean SHA-256 monitoring and zero ongoing subscription fees.
pillar: Get an alert (Discord, Telegram or email) when a file or a page you are allowed to monitor changes
